description: Phantom-mass amplitude and radial-profile test on SPARC
method: Plateau ratio = median V_obs/V_bar over outer third of each curve (signed V_gas convention). Linear-kinetic baseline S_eff = (ratio^2 - 1)/(2 beta_A^2) with |beta_A| = 1 (ceiling sqrt(3) = 1.732), evaluated alongside the selected two-branch kinetic completion P_X = eps_reg + k sqrt(xi) + 2 xi (k = 16.03, zero free parameters). Enhancement profile slope = d log E / d log R with E = V_obs^2/V_bar^2 - 1 = M_ph/M_bar(<R). V_bar floor 5.0 km/s, >= 6 valid points required.
